query: Please implement an open-source development framework website for showcasing and downloading the framework. The website should have functionalities for displaying framework features, version update records, download links, community discussion, and suggestion collection. Users should be able to browse the framework introduction, download the latest version, view update history, participate in community discussions, and submit suggestions. Set page background to apricot; color all components with chocolate.
